HARSHITH DESHALLI RAVI
Chicago, IL | (224)-566 5998 | harshithdr10@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/harshith-deshalli-ravi/ | https://github.com/HarshithDR

EDUCATION
Illinois Institute of Technology, M.S. in Data Science (Aug 2023 - Dec 2025)
Coursework: Advanced Machine Learning, Deep Learning for Robotics, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Robotics Simulation, Edge AI, Motion Planning, Probabilistic Robots, Advanced Statistics, Monte-Carlo Statistics, Generative AI Models.

Global Academy of Technology, B.E. in Electrical and Electronics (Aug 2019 - Jul 2023)
Coursework: Robotics Systems and Control, Modern Control Theory, Sensors and Actuators, Embedded Systems Design, Motor Design, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Linear Algebra, Advanced Calculus, Battery Management System (BMS), Computer Architecture.

EXPERIENCE
Robotics Researcher - Illinois Institute of Technology, USA (Sep 2024 – Present)
- Enhanced operator control accuracy by 40% and achieved <100 ms force-feedback latency with 1 mm positional precision through optimized real-time control loops and calibrated feedback motors.
- Constructed a 5-DOF wearable exoskeleton enabling real-time haptic teleoperation, providing tactile feedback of remote robot forces for intuitive and responsive control.
- Integrated ROS, motor control systems, and VR hardware within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to synchronize user body motion with robot movement, enabling a complete sim-to-real digital twin workflow.
- Validated through 20+ simulation and real-world trials, demonstrating significant improvement in immersion, stability, and system responsiveness during teleoperation tasks.

Robotics Research Assistant - Indian Institute of Technology Bengaluru, India (Oct 2022 – Apr 2023)
- Improved learning rate by 50% among 30+ children with autism by deploying interactive social robots that taught balance, path following, and language using emotion-aware cues and emoji-based expressions.
- Designed and programmed two mobile robots powered by ROS2, Raspberry Pi, dual cameras, and ultrasonic sensors for adaptive movement and behavior-based engagement.
- Achieved ~95% tracking accuracy in movement through PID control and path-planning algorithms, enabling precise robot motion in dynamic classroom environments.
- Enhanced robot response and stability by 30% via improved hardware–software integration, sensor calibration, and optimized control loops for smooth human–robot interaction

Edge AI & Computer Vision Engineer - DHI Flagship and Innovation Centre, India (Jun 2021 – Nov 2022)
- Achieved 95% object detection accuracy across a 50,000+ image dataset by deploying real-time detection models for public transport and currency recognition using Python, OpenCV, and YOLOv5.
- Reduced inference latency by 30% on Raspberry Pi and Jetson devices through model compression and TensorFlow Lite conversion, maintaining accuracy above 95% for edge deployment.
- Enhanced accessibility and response time by 30% for visually impaired users by integrating an NLP-driven speech interface built with NLTK, Apache Spark, and SQL, containerized with Docker for scalable rollout.

SKILLS
Programming & Software: Python, C++, ROS/ROS2, Git, Real-Time Microcontroller Programming, CI/CD Pipelines, Docker.
Robotics & AI: Robot Kinematics & Dynamics, Motion & Trajectory Planning (RRT*, PID, MPC), SLAM & Sensor Fusion, ML & DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX), Reinforcement Learning (DQN, PPO), Computer Vision (OpenCV, YOLO, 3D Point Clouds).
Simulation & Hardware: Gazebo, Isaac Sim, Digital Twin Simulation, Sensor Integration (IMU, LiDAR, Cameras), Embedded Systems (Arduino, STM32, Raspberry Pi), CAD/CAM (SolidWorks, Fusion 360)

ACADEMIC PROJECTS
- 3D LiDAR-Based SLAM and Autonomous Navigation using ROS2 and Isaac Sim: Revamped fully autonomous navigation with accurate localization and smooth trajectory planning in a simulated environment (NVIDIA Omniverse) using Nav2 and real-time collision avoidance. Generated high-fidelity 3D point cloud maps using Cartographer and 3D LiDAR, converted them into 2D costmaps, and integrated via an Isaac Sim–ROS2 bridge for seamless sensor data exchange and control.
- AI Manipulator - Multi-Modal Robotic Control using Isaac Sim and NVIDIA Groot N1.5: Achieved real-time multi-modal manipulation (gesture, audio, and perception-driven control) on the Open Manipulator X by fine-tuning NVIDIA’s Groot N1.5 foundation model using large-scale synthetic data from a custom Isaac Sim environment. Integrated ROS2-based simulation–hardware pipeline with a custom AI interface on Jetson Nano (dual cameras + depth sensor), enabling real-time inference, motion planning, and adaptive pick-and-place execution.

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Secured Top 5 global ranking out of 4,500+ participants at TikTok TechJam, with 5+ podium finishes in 10+ national and international hackathons.
- Led the design and development of an electric go-kart, achieving a Top 5 finish at the Indian National Kart Racing (IKR) Championship, representing the state team.
